sentences.en: My favorite children's book is The Wind in the Willows.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的儿童书籍是《柳林风声》。

sentences.en: Yanni uses black willow bark to weave these wonderful baskets.
sentences.zh: Yanni用黑柳树皮编织这些精美的篮子。

sentences.en: Willow branches don't break under the weight of snow.
sentences.zh: 柳树枝不会被积雪压断。

senses.zh: [林] 柳树；[木] 柳木制品
